reviews.title: Solid and Stable (AMD Build)
reviews.comment:
The RAM seems stable. I did have to update my BIOS to get it to work correctly at 6400MT/s. This was for an all new PC build, so I can't really say how much it impacts the overall speed of my computer, though my PC is fast. I'm using the RAM on a MSI B850 motherboard with a Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU. The value is debatable as RAM prices surged in late 2025, forcing me to purchase a different brand than I had intended, and spend twice as much as I wanted to.
Also, due to the high product cost, Amazon definitely should have shipped it in a box, not a brown paper envelope. While the packaging got beat up, the inner plastic was okay and the RAM had no damage itself.
reviews.author: JMS75

reviews.title: Well worth the price
reviews.comment:
It works as intended and is a great addition to any gaming rig or PC needing extra ram. It's a great value compared to other brands. I haven't had any issues with it at all. Well worth the price!
And the low profile worked well with the massive graphics card I have. It fits great for my system. Obviously do your homework to make sure it will fit in your system, but if it does then why hesitate when it's on par with more expensive brands?
